prompt_definitions.weak_label: cache.train_prompts[image_id], including hypothetical corresponding template for U

contract.latent_policy: reuse original cached FP16 VAE posterior-mode latent promoted to FP32; no new VAE
contract.hidden_policy: reuse cached FP16 text hidden promoted to FP32; no new tokenizer/text encoder
contract.noise_policy: CPU torch.randn FP32 (1,4,32,32), seed=int.from_bytes(sha256('promptloss-v1|260915|image_id|140')[:8],'big') mod(2**63-1); shared by all models and prompts
contract.model_policy: fresh actual pretrained no-LoRA base plus original step1000 rank8 targets; FP32 eval, no autocast/CFG/gradient checkpointing/backward

precommitted_analysis.fit80: descriptive summaries only; no fitting or prompt choice
precommitted_analysis.patient_score: mean over two same-scenario images, negative target MSE; secondary same-prompt base MSE minus target MSE
precommitted_analysis.bootstrap: reuse original2000 selection A20/B20 draws; no new threshold or direction
precommitted_analysis.base_label: A/B assignment only; all incremental base membership0, pretrained membershipunknown

contract.scope: one-timestep/noise fixed conditioning diagnostic on existing patients; no new target training, attack fitting, claim of patient privacy efficacy, or stage2 completion

source_policy: Cached FP16 VAE posterior mode and text embeddings promoted to FP32; three fixed conditions
noise_policy: CPU FP32 one epsilon per image, shared across all three models and prompts
weak_label_policy: Cached image-specific template; for unseen U this is a hypothetical caption, not a prompt used to train that U image
downstream_analysis: Separate frozen analysis/verification contract required after complete raw extraction; no performance analysis in producer
